  "body": "Problem: Trail commands currently target the control-plane BFF for all operations, but the new production backend (entire-api) uses different conventions: camelCase instead of snake_case, cursor pagination instead of offset/limit, repo/number addressing instead of trail ID, and uses 204 No Content for deletion instead of a response body.\nSolution: Migrate trail commands to route directly to the entire-api cell that owns the repository. The changes include:\nAutomatic payload normalization: New normalizeLegacyTrailJSON() and custom UnmarshalJSON() methods on response types transparently convert between snake_case (BFF/test fixtures) and camelCase (entire-api) so both formats work seamlessly.\nCursor-based pagination: Replace offset/limit with opaque page tokens and cursor pagination. The server page cap changed from 200 to 100 rows.       "body": "Two normalizers in this PR; only the SSE one protects free-form data\n\n`normalizeTrailEventValue` (`trail_watch_cmd.go`) deliberately exempts the free-form key so event data is not re-cased:\n\n```go\nif key == \"payload\" {\n    out[key] = child\n    continue\n}\n```\n\n`normalizeTrailJSONValue` here has no equivalent guard — it re-cases every key at every depth, on both the read path (`decodeNormalizedTrailJSON`, used by ~13 UnmarshalJSON methods across trail/review/thread types) and the write path (`legacyTrailRequestBody`, which every request body on the **default** backend passes through).\n\nVerified against this head (512908dc6):\n\n```\nread   {\"id\":\"t1\",\"context\":{\"my_custom_key\":1},\"labels\":{\"team_a\":true}}\n    -\u003e {\"id\":\"t1\",\"context\":{\"myCustomKey\":1},\"labels\":{\"teamA\":true}}\n\nwrite  {\"metadata\":{\"userDefinedKey\":1,\"already_snake\":2}}\n    -\u003e {\"metadata\":{\"user_defined_key\":1,\"already_snake\":2}}\n```\n\n**Latent, not live:** no trail type currently declares a `map[string]any`; the only free-form field is `TrailApproval.Author` (`json.RawMessage`), and re-casing an author object is harmless. Severity: medium
Context: cmd/entire/cli/api/trail_types.go:88
Selected context:
```
r.Branch = r.OriginalBranch
```
`TrailResource.UnmarshalJSON` unconditionally backfills `Branch` from `OriginalBranch` whenever the server sends `branch: null`. That erases the distinction between "trail never had a branch" and "trail's branch was explicitly unlinked" for every consumer of `.Branch`, including `runTrailCheckout` (`trail_cmd.go`, `found.Branch == ""` guard) and `runTrailResume` (`trail_resume_cmd.go:225-227`), which use this field to decide whether to `git checkout`/resume a branch and to key local session-context lookup by branch name. If entire-api unlinks a branch (deleted/reused), the CLI will now silently attempt to check out or resume against the stale `OriginalBranch` instead of reporting "has no branch", risking checkout of unrelated branch content or misattributed session state.

- keep the legacy BFF implementation as the default trail backend
- allow opting into the new backend with `ENTIRE_TRAILS_BACKEND=entire-api`

# Default: legacy BFF
